A [[Gender|male]] '''Hosnian''' was on the [[planet]] [[Hosnian Prime]] during the [[Cold War]]. In [[34 ABY]], approximately thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], the [[First Order]] fired the [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]] at the [[New Republic]] [[capital]], destroying Hosnian Prime along with its population.<ref name="TFA" />

At the [[time]] of his [[death]], the Hosnian was in [[Republic City]] where he and [[Senator|members]] of the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]] witnessed beams of energy moving toward the [[Hosnian system]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
He was voiced by [[Tom Kane]].<ref name="Voices" />
